# device42_pdu (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_pdu" "myNewPdu" {
   name          = "PDU-01"
   pdu_serial_no = "ABC12345"
   pdu_model     = "AP8865"
   notes         = "Rack A PDU"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the PDU. Create only.

### Optional

- `gateway_pdu_id` (String) Identifier of the parent/gateway PDU.
- `notes` (String) Any additional notes for the PDU.
- `pdu_model` (String) Name of the PDU model this PDU is based on.
- `pdu_serial_no` (String) Serial number of the PDU. Create only.

### Read-Only

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom fields associated with the PDU.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pdu_model_id` (String) Identifier of the PDU model.
